extracted.name: Mandy's SOFT Doughnuts!
extracted.description: These taste just like a krispy cream if not better
ingredient_lines: 2 packages yeast or 4-1/2 tsp 1/3 cup warm agua
5-6 cups or less of all purpose flour
instruction_lines: Add your wet ingredients with the sugar stir and yeast put aside let the yeast activate 3-5min get fluffy
Slowly mix in your flour note:you might use less or more depending on the humidity.
Knead Till a soft sticky dough forms on your counter or table try not to add too much flour. * the dough needs to be sticky but not stick to your hands* knead till smooth.
Set a side in a greased bowl to rise till it doubles in size.
Once it rises punch down knead and let it rise again.
Once it has risen you can roll out 1/2" thick use cookie cutters to cut your shapes. Or a mason lid with a soda cap
Set aside to rise 8th Heat oil 350° 9th fry flip until golden And glaze while hot
Toppings I did cinnamon sugar Chocolate and glaze Powdered sugar Sprinkles. These Donuts are light and fluffy
